subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should operator.read clients that can query a session also be allowed to receive bytes for managed images referenced by that same session transcript, while direct HTTP remains owner/admin-only?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well-proven, but final acceptance of this new local-byte authorization path requires explicit ownership of the Gateway trust boundary.

options.title: Approve the scoped RPC path
options.body: Confirm the session-and-transcript binding as the intended operator.read contract and land after reviewing the exact merge result.

options.title: Require a stronger scope
options.body: Change managed-image byte downloads to require operator.admin or another explicit ownership gate before landing.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped RPC path
recommendation.body: Confirm the session-and-transcript binding as the intended operator.read contract and land after reviewing the exact merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent credited work owns the managed-image HTTP lazy-loading and authorization-adjacent boundary most directly affected by this decision.
